spec: Per COMBAT_AND_CLASS_OVERHAUL_PLAN.md §6.1 — 3 paths × ~27 nodes; 51 points total; tier-N gates at (N-1)*5 points; tier-7 capstone gates at ~31 points; multi-rank passives ~70%; identity/keystone ~30%.
designNotes: Class-First Principle (LOCKED §4.2): class trees are weapon-agnostic. NO weapon-conditional nodes. Tag-conditional nodes (channel, hybrid-damage, conversion) ARE allowed since tags apply across weapons via morphs.

Idle-game context: no movement/standing mechanics; combat is per-zone encounter; no tile concept (use 'all enemies in encounter' / 'in zone'). Chill is reframed as combat-action-speed slow (not movement), per idle-friendly directive.

Multi-rank flavor directive: 18 of 81 nodes (~22%) are pure stat-sticks; the remaining 63 carry proc/conditional/identity/cross-weapon flavor. Slightly above 20% target — Sor has more stat-foundation nodes due to Resonance bank size, mana, max charges, ignite stacking. Reasonable for the caster archetype.
Buff migrations: 0 (Sor pool not yet authored — no audited active buffs to migrate per SKILL_FANTASY_AUDIT scope).
Cross-weapon node: Cross-Weapon Convergence (Specialist T6) — Resonance and Convergence trigger regardless of weapon (per §8.2 cross-weapon combo-state propagation).

All 3 capstones reshape Resonance signature: Element Shifter (Elementalist) makes element-swap procs reset Resonance counter (free Convergence cycles); Saturation (Arcanist) raises Resonance cap +5 + grants cast-speed burst on spend; Avatar of Element (Specialist) commits to one element + protects chosen-element charge from element-swap reset.
Base-mechanic dependencies tracked per-node in `dependencies` array.

categoryDistribution._note: Multi-rank flavor distribution: 63 of 81 nodes (~78%) carry proc/conditional/identity/cross-weapon flavor; 18 (~22%) are pure stat-sticks.
